# /feature-flow — Traces a specific feature end-to-end through the kit: shows which spec files define it, which template vars it injects, which templates consume those vars, what generated output it produces, and what overlay settings control it. Use this to understand or debug a feature's behavior.

## When to Use

Invoke this command when the user requests or implies the
`feature-flow` operation.

## Purpose

Traces a specific feature end-to-end through the kit: shows which spec files define it, which template vars it injects, which templates consume those vars, what generated output it produces, and what overlay settings control it. Use this to understand or debug a feature's behavior.

## Shared State

This command participates in the shared workflow state. Read and update:

- **AGENT_BACKLOG.md** — Prioritized work items; read before starting, update when adding/completing tasks
- **.windsurf/state/orchestrator.json** — Phase, team status, metrics; read for context
- **.windsurf/state/events.log** — Append a log line when completing significant actions

## Flags

| Flag               | Description                                                   | Default |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--feature`        | Feature ID to trace (e.g., team-orchestration, quality-gates) |         |
| `--show-templates` | Show the raw template content that uses this feature          | false   |
| `--show-output`    | Show the rendered output for this feature                     | false   |
